tool_input.body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for your quote for 1,200 pens of NDC 0169-4524-14 at USD 285.00 per pen. Two points do not match our requirements:

1. Expiry: the offered expiry of 10/27 (2027-10-31) is earlier than our required minimum of 2028-06-30. We need stock with expiry on or after 2028-06-30.

2. Single lot: the offer is split across 3 lots (A1001, A1002, A1003). We need all 1,200 pens from a single lot.

Please also confirm:
- Price per pen for stock that meets the above (your quote was USD 285.00 per pen).
- Lead time in days.
- Storage condition of 2-8C.

If you cannot meet both points, please tell us what you can offer.

Best regards,
Jamie Park
TransPharmic
